newsitem.title: USA: Rail talks may stall with no confidential pact - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Rail talks may stall with no confidential pact - NYT.

text.p: CSX, Norfolk Southern and Conrail meet today in Washington to discuss the acquisition of Conrail, but the companies might not address any substantive issues, the New York Times said Friday.
The paper said Conrail sought to obtain a confidentiality agreement shielding the discussions and refused to hold substantive talks about routes and revenues without such a pact.
The paper said Conrail and Norfolk Southern wrangled yesterday over a confidentiality agreement and that executives from all three rail firms opted to continue with the meeting.
